_comment: Per-provider enablement and settings. Providers register themselves in code (Providers/*.ps1); this file only tunes them. An unknown key here is reported at load time rather than ignored silently.

Settings._allowResetBaseComment: DISM /ResetBase makes every currently installed update permanently non-uninstallable. Off by default; enabling it only makes the recommendation available, it is still HIGH risk and needs individual approval.

Settings._reportOnlyComment: The services provider is advisory by design. Setting this to false has no effect while Config/policies.json ships an empty ServiceRecommendations list.

Settings._scopeComment: Cache only. History, cookies, sessions, autofill, saved passwords, bookmarks and extensions are never targeted.

Settings._allowVolumePruneComment: Volumes hold the data containers were built to keep. This flag is honoured only to the extent of surfacing volumes for manual review; the provider emits no automatic volume removal regardless of its value.

Settings._advisoryComment: Microsoft documents how to expand a WSL virtual disk but publishes no supported in-place shrink procedure on the disk-space page. Compaction is therefore explained, never performed.

Settings._comment: Disabled by default and advisory only. Requires Config defaults Safety.AllowExternalTools to be true as well. Czkawka is never downloaded or installed by this toolkit; it is used only if the user has already installed it and enabled it here. Duplicate detection produces a report, never a deletion.
